case_title: KA LAI AU VS. AUGUSTO ATIENZA APOLONIA

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-12-2024 - JUDGMENT.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-07-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JAN-12-2024 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF KA LAI AU IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT AUGUSTO ATIENZA APOLONIA IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR DEFENDANT TO MOVE OUT OF PLAINTIFF'S HOME BY DEC-24-2023. DEFENDANT WILL PAY THE PLAINTIFF $130 BY THE DATE OF THE MOVE OUT. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE JAN-12-2024 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED.JUDGE PRO TEM: CURTIS SMOLAR; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
